home_title.zh: 終端機 RSS 閱讀器｜go-rss-reader

en.home: go-rss-reader by Pardn Chiu is a terminal RSS reader in Go with full-article extraction, SQLite offline cache, and a rolling AI news summary via OpenAI.
en.getting-started: Build go-rss-reader from source with CGO, add your first RSS feed, read full articles in the terminal, and enable the LLM digest.
en.architecture: Layer overview of go-rss-reader: TUI app, RSS collector, content extractor, OpenAI client, and SQLite storage, plus cross-cutting rules.
en.refresh-cycle: How one update check runs: launch, Ctrl+R, and the 5-minute ticker, new-article detection, background extraction, then the digest.
en.feed-collection: How Collector manages feeds and parses RSS 2.0: deduplication by link, the 72-hour window, HTML cleanup, and pubDate formats.
en.content-extraction: How Extractor pulls title, author, and body from news pages with goquery: noise removal, link-density body selection, and word count.
en.llm-digest: When the AI news summary in the Summary pane runs, what gets sent to gpt-4o-mini, the Traditional Chinese output sections, and the streaming client.
en.storage: SQLite schema of go-rss-reader: the news, feeds, and data tables, their indexes, and every database.SQLite access method.
en.configuration: Configure go-rss-reader: RSS_DB_PATH and GO_ENV, database file resolution order, the stored OpenAI API key, and fixed parameters.
en.cli-reference: go-rss-reader hotkeys, in-app commands (add, rm, apikey, config), pane layout, and status bar messages.

zh.home: 邱敬幃開發的 Go 終端機 RSS 閱讀器（RSS reader），具備閱讀模式全文萃取、SQLite 離線快取與 OpenAI 滾動式 AI 新聞摘要。
zh.getting-started: 以 CGO 從原始碼建置 go-rss-reader、加入第一個 RSS 訂閱源、在終端讀全文並啟用 LLM 概要。
zh.architecture: go-rss-reader 分層概覽：TUI 應用層、RSS 收集器、全文萃取器、OpenAI 用戶端與 SQLite 儲存及跨切原則。
zh.refresh-cycle: 一次檢查更新的完整順序：啟動、Ctrl+R 與 5 分鐘自動檢查、新文章判定、背景全文萃取到產生概要。
zh.feed-collection: Collector 如何管理訂閱源並解析 RSS 2.0：依連結去重、72 小時時間窗、HTML 清理與 pubDate 格式。
zh.content-extraction: Extractor 如何以 goquery 從新聞網頁取出標題、作者與正文：雜訊移除、連結密度判定正文與字數計算。
zh.llm-digest: Summary 欄 AI 新聞摘要的觸發條件、送交 gpt-4o-mini 的內容、繁體中文輸出段落與串流 API 用戶端。
zh.storage: go-rss-reader 的 SQLite 結構：news、feeds、data 三張資料表、索引與 database.SQLite 所有存取方法。
zh.configuration: go-rss-reader 設定：RSS_DB_PATH 與 GO_ENV、資料庫檔案位置判斷順序、儲存的 OpenAI 金鑰與固定參數。
zh.cli-reference: go-rss-reader 快捷鍵、介面內指令（add、rm、apikey、config）、介面區塊配置與狀態列訊息。
